title: Cute Cat Couch For Pets - Fluffy Cat Beds With Premium Soft Corduroy Fleece, Fuzzy Cats Beds For Indoor Cats With Removable Washable Cover, Supportive Pet Sofa
body_html: This minimalist cream vertical stripe plush pet sofa perfectly combines home decor aesthetics and comfortable sleep for your furry friends, ideal for Corgis, French Bulldogs, Chihuahuas, Shiba Inus and all sizes of cats, matching wood & cream-style home interiors seamlessly. Cloud-Like Vertical Strip Plush Fabric Thick puffy vertical stripe faux fur delivers ultra-soft cloud touch with premium fluffy texture, anti-shedding and skin-friendly for pets. It keeps pets warm in winter and breathable in mild weather, relieving separation anxiety with its cozy soft surface. The solid cream minimalist tone blends naturally with living rooms, bedrooms and balconies without clashing your home decor. Surround Raised Backrest for Spine Support & Security 3-sided high curved bolster creates an enclosed hugging nest. It provides full support for pets’ neck and spine to avoid soreness after long resting. The low flat entry makes it super easy for short-legged dogs, senior pets and tiny kittens to step on and off. The wrapped enclosed design offers a safe hiding spot for timid pets who love curling up to sleep. High-Density Elastic Filling, No Permanent Collapse Filled with high-resilience PP cotton, evenly distributed for stable weight support. The sofa holds its shape well even after long-term daily use, no lump or sinking issue when dogs jump or lie on it, much more supportive than flat regular pet beds. Fully Detachable & Machine Washable Cover Hidden invisible zipper design allows you to take off the entire outer cover easily. The fabric is machine washable, resistant to pilling and deformation after washing, convenient to remove pet hair, stains and unpleasant odor for long-lasting clean use. Non-Slip Silent Bottom, Floor Friendly Anti-slip mute base fabric prevents the couch from sliding on wooden floors and fluffy rugs. The material resists light scratching without snagging, keeps your floor scratch-free and stays quiet when pets move around. Perfect for daily indoor napping, rest for puppies and senior dogs, suitable for all small & medium dog breeds and cats.
